owner: CC owns the code and the proofs. Akien owns the intention itself
workflow_and_state: code-seam@v2: THINKME -> TICKETME -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> WATCHME(the-lookups-actually-stop) -> [PROVED]

watchme.trigger: each read of the probe over ~/.cairn/devices/chart/0/packets — no clock and no new firing path; it rides the shim's existing pulse and the read-side overdue() door, the same seam every other probe in the corpus sits on. TRUE when at least 10 constrain packets have berthed carrying discovered checks AND the median number of checks they carry is below 2 — a floor that discovers almost nothing is the failure that looks exactly like a floor that had little to find, and only the count separates them. The bar is 2 because the smallest real build in this corpus touches one component with a proofs/ peer and crosses one gate.
watchme.enough: CLEARED when at least 10 such packets have berthed AND the median check count is at or above 2 AND at least one packet carries a check the floor reported RED — the existence claim the code cannot make about itself, because a report that has only ever said green is indistinguishable from a report that cannot say anything else. Deliberately NOT cleared on 'the packets got bigger': Akien's measure is the lookups that stop, and packet size is the proxy that moves when the thing does not.
watchme.carrier: cairn/devices/builder/machines/constrain/probes/lookups_stop.py — module-level PROBE carrying the post-door packet count, the per-packet check counts, how many distinct instruments have ever been discovered, the green/red tally, and the discovery sources that returned nothing (a source that never yields is either wrong or gone, and both are findings).
watchme.nexus: hypothesize — 'the floor is discovering nothing' is a hypothesis about why, not a fact about what: a wrong discovery convention, refs that ground nowhere, and a corpus with genuinely few checks near the work are three different causes and the report carries what separates them.
watchme.consumer: harbor_master. It deposits and pokes and carries no authority: the back-edge that re-opens this ticket is the owner's act (Law 6). A fire means check the ref grounding first — a floor whose refs reach no component discovers no checks, and that is constrain's OWN prior defect resurfacing rather than this build failing.
